exports.index.js: public staging exports (config.js, adapter.js except invalid, service.js)

auth.identity: selected connection only; connectionId recorded in accounting; no credential mutation, cache, refresh, replay or failover

envelope.request: POST https://s.jina.ai/ JSON { q, num: min(max_results || 5, 50), gl?: country (upper-cased), hl?: language, page?: offset when > 0 } with Content-Type/Accept application/json and Authorization: Bearer
envelope.response: local search envelope { provider: 'jina-search', query, results: SearchResult[], answer: null, usage: { queries_used: 1, search_cost_usd: 0.002 }, metrics, errors } rebuilt from validated items of a bare array, `data` or `results`

integration.provider: add jinaSearchProviderDefinition as new open-sse/providers/registry/jina-search.js (serviceKinds ['webSearch'], searchConfig); no existing local provider uses this id, so nothing is replaced
integration.search: open-sse/handlers/search/index.js handleSearchCore: dispatch handleJinaSearchNative for provider 'jina-search' before tryDedicatedProvider; callers.js/normalizers.js have no jina-search builder or normalizer: the generic fallback would POST { query, max_results, search_type } (not the source { q, num } envelope) and normalize to zero results
integration.route: src/sse/handlers/search.js handleSingleProviderSearch resolves `jina` to the jina-ai embedding provider; request-only aliases jina-ai/jina -> jina-search apply to /v1/search routing only and must never change resolveProviderId
integration.credentials: source reuses jina-ai connections (SEARCH_CREDENTIAL_FALLBACKS); registration must select from jina-search first, then jina-ai, keeping the selected connection's identity and quota scope; jina-reader reuse is a comment in the source registry, not a mapping
integration.catalog: docs/providers/catalog.mdx and shared catalogs updated at serial registration only

restrictions: unregistered pending serial registration after four additions
search_type 'web' only; time_range only absent or 'any'; domain_filter, content_options and provider_options refused unless empty (the source silently drops them)
query 1..500 characters after NFKC/whitespace normalization; control bytes refused
max_results positive integer, clamped to 50 as the source does; offset integer 0..100 forwarded verbatim as `page` (source mapping)
country two letters; language 2-3 letters with optional short region
fixed origin https://s.jina.ai; caller/connection base URL overrides are not honored; redirects refused
15s default / 60s maximum per-call deadline, also bounded by an absolute deadlineAt; 8MiB success and 16KiB error response bounds
result URLs must be public http(s) without userinfo; unsafe items are dropped and counted in errors
upstream error messages and bodies are never relayed
Jina meta.usage.tokens recorded as nativeUnits.jina_tokens only; ledger cost stays unknown
no streaming, answer synthesis, polling, browser or WebSocket protocol; no dynamic model discovery exists in the source
